title: Annotatio I §.I Time: First mutual dissent after egress from papal Babylon was on Supper questions
pass_a_gloss: But truly by priority partly of time — because, having gone out from papal Babylon, Protestants first of all began to dissent from one another in some questions concerning the Lord’s Supper;
pass_b_english: They are prior partly by time.
Once out of papal Babylon, Protestants first began to dissent from one another on some questions about the Lord’s Supper.
source_text: Sed verò prioritate partim temporis, quòd Babylone pontificiâ egressi, primò omnium, in nonnullis de Coena Domini quaestionibus, à se invicem dissentire coeperint Protestantes;

lemmas.gloss: having gone out from papal Babylon

notes: Prioritas temporis; first Coena dissent post-Babylon.
